title: Annual Leave Policy
content: Employees receive 18 paid annual leave days per calendar year. Unused leave can be carried forward up to 10 days. Leave requests must be applied 2 days in advance. Manager approval required.

title: Sick Leave Policy
content: Employees receive 10 sick leave days annually. Medical certificate required if leave exceeds 3 consecutive days. Unused sick leave expires yearly.

title: Casual Leave Policy
content: Employees are allowed 6 casual leave days yearly. Casual leave cannot be carried forward. Maximum 2 casual leaves can be taken continuously.

title: Work From Home Policy
content: Employees may work from home 2 days per week. Approval from reporting manager required. Must be online from 10 AM to 4 PM.

title: Probation Policy
content: New employees undergo 3 months probation. Performance review conducted after probation. Benefits activate after confirmation.

title: Salary Policy
content: Salary is credited on the last working day of every month. Payslips available in HR portal.

title: Working Hours
content: Office timings: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday. Total weekly hours = 40.

title: Travel Reimbursement
content: Eligible expenses include airfare (economy), hotel, meals, and local transport. Claims must be submitted within 7 days with bills.

title: Employee Benefits
content: Employees are eligible after probation for health insurance, provident fund, bonus, and paid parental leave.

title: Notice Period
content: Employees must serve a 30 days notice period. Buyout is subject to approval.

title: Code of Conduct
content: No harassment, discrimination, or data misuse is allowed. Violations lead to disciplinary action.

title: Attendance Policy
content: Employees must mark attendance daily. Late login beyond 15 minutes is considered late. Three late attendances may lead to a warning. Missed attendance must be regularized within 2 days.

title: Overtime Policy
content: Overtime requires manager approval. Only approved hours are counted. Not applicable for managerial roles.

title: Public Holiday Policy
content: Company observes national and regional holidays. Holiday calendar is shared yearly. Working on holidays may provide compensatory leave.

title: Maternity Leave Policy
content: Eligible employees get 26 weeks of paid leave. Medical documents are required. Extra unpaid leave may be allowed.

title: Paternity Leave Policy
content: Male employees get 5 days leave. Leave must be used within 30 days of childbirth.

title: Asset Policy
content: Employees must handle company devices responsibly. Loss or damage must be reported. Assets must be returned during exit.

title: Internet Reimbursement Policy
content: Remote employees can claim internet bills up to $30 per month. Bills must be submitted in the HR portal.

title: Learning and Development Policy
content: Employees can take internal training. Certifications may be reimbursed. This is used in performance evaluation.

title: Performance Appraisal Policy
content: Reviews happen annually based on goals and contributions. Bonus depends on performance.

title: Dress Code Policy
content: Professional attire is required. Casual wear is allowed on Fridays. Improper dress may lead to notice.

title: Data Security Policy
content: Employees must not share passwords or confidential data. Unauthorized copying is prohibited. Security issues must be reported immediately.

title: Exit Policy
content: Knowledge transfer is required. All assets must be returned. Final settlement is done after clearance.

title: Payroll Policy
content: Salary is processed monthly. Tax is deducted as per rules. Bank details must be updated.

title: Remote Work Policy
content: Stable internet is required. Employees must be available during work hours. Regular communication is expected.

title: Internal Transfer Policy
content: Employees are eligible for internal transfer after 12 months based on performance and business needs.

title: Grievance Policy
content: Employees can raise concerns to HR confidentially. All complaints are investigated fairly.
